# Help improve Claudian.app

This repository provides public releases, documentation and support. Claudian development is moving to a closed-source model; historical source snapshots remain visible while the transition is planned. Application source-code contributions are not accepted here.

## Report a bug or suggest an improvement

Use an [issue template](https://github.com/GeneralBobi/claudian-app/issues/new/choose). Include the application version, Windows version, AI tool and the steps needed to reproduce the problem. Describe what you expected and what happened.

Use a small fictional example. Do not upload your vault, chat history, recordings, account credentials, connection URLs containing device identifiers, or unreviewed logs. Remove private information from screenshots.

## Improve documentation

Focused documentation corrections are welcome. Open an issue before proposing a large rewrite. A pull request should explain the correction and how links or instructions were checked. Do not add release-note files; release notes belong in GitHub Releases.

## Security reports

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not publish vulnerability details in a public issue.

Please follow the [community guidelines](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
